picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 45, 2 segment(s), 39s
-- segment 1: 00:22.90 to 00:42.05 --
[00:22.90-00:24.40] JULIANA (Shocked, Wondering): "You're the Duke?"
[00:24.50-00:27.20] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.
[00:24.60-00:27.40] ALEXANDER (Firm, Resonant): "Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."
[00:27.20-00:29.80] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.
[00:27.60-00:29.60] JULIANA (Incredulous, Moved): "All this time?"
[00:29.80-00:35.80] CAMERA: Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.
[00:30.20-00:33.00] ALEXANDER (Tender, Deep): "You chose me when you believed I was nobody."
[00:33.20-00:34.90] JULIANA (Sincere, Loving): "I chose you because you were kind."
[00:35.10-00:36.80] ALEXANDER (Low, Passionate): "You chose me when I had nothing."
[00:35.80-00:38.50] CAMERA: Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.
[00:37.00-00:38.70] JULIANA (Resolute, Warm): "I chose you because you had honor."
[00:38.50-00:42.00] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.
[00:38.80-00:41.80] ALEXANDER (Earnest, Devoted): "And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."
[00:42.00-00:42.05] CAMERA: Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.
-- segment 2: 01:33.20 to 01:53.25 --
[01:33.20-01:41.00] ACTION: The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.
[01:33.20-01:41.10] HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe): "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
[01:41.20-01:45.80] CAMERA: Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.
[01:41.50-01:45.50] HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Official): "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."
[01:45.80-01:48.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.
[01:46.20-01:48.80] HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Resolute): "Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."
[01:48.80-01:53.20] CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.
[01:49.00-01:53.00] HIGH PRIEST (Unyielding, Condemning): "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."
[01:53.20-01:53.25] CAMERA: Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.

[01:07.00-01:11.20] CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.
[01:08.80-01:10.50] CATHERINE (Trembling, Stunned): "Wife?!"
[01:11.20-01:14.50] CAMERA: Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.
[01:11.20-01:14.50] ACTION: Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.
[01:11.50-01:14.00] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Resounding): "Before the Crown and before God..."
[01:14.50-01:20.50] CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stops in the center of the nave and raises Juliana's hand high above their heads.
[01:14.60-01:20.00] ACTION: Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.
[01:14.80-01:20.40] ALEXANDER (Proclaiming, Powerful): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!"
[01:20.50-01:23.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert and Mary standing in the pews, their eyes wide with horrified disbelief.
[01:21.50-01:23.00] RUPERT (Gasping, Shellshocked): "Juliana?!"
[01:23.50-01:26.50] CAMERA: Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing proudly together, exchanging a loving gaze amid the awestruck crowd.
[01:26.50-01:30.50] CAMERA: Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.
[01:26.50-01:28.20] SOUND: Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
[01:27.50-01:31.00] ACTION: A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.
[01:28.40-01:30.80] HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Stern): "No one will bow yet!"
[01:30.80-01:31.05] CAMERA: Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
